items.name: Rockslicer
stats: Use: Slice open and gather from a target Copper, Tin, Silver, or Iron Vein (does not require Mining).

items.name: Bandsaw Wristbands
stats: Equip: Deals 5 to 7 Physical damage every time you block.

items.name: Gold-plated Buckler
stats: Equip: After entering combat, reduce the next instance of Physical damage taken within 20 sec by 15.

items.name: Smelting Pants
stats: Equip: Reduces the crafting time of Smelt Copper, Smelt Tin, Smelt Bronze, and Smelt Silver by 25%.

items.name: Thief's Blade
stats: Equip: Increases the chance your Pick Pocket and Distract abilities are successful by 1%

items.name: Cookie's Tenderizer
stats: Chance on hit: Tenderize the target, increasing physical damage taken by 1 for 1 min.

items.name: Cookie's Stirring Rod
stats: Equip: Increases your Cooking speed by 25%.

items.name: Lookie's Spyglass
stats: Use: Allows you to look far into the distance.

items.name: Stinging Viper
stats: Chance on hit: Poisons target for 7 Nature damage every 3 sec for 12 sec.

items.name: Venomstrike
stats: Chance on hit: Venom Shot the target for 23 to 33 Nature damage.

items.name: Sporid Cape
stats: Equip: When struck in combat, inflicts 1 Nature damage to the attacker.

items.name: Spiked Shell Band
stats: Equip: When struck in combat, inflicts 2 Nature damage to the attacker.

items.name: Tortoise Armor
stats: Equip: Spell Damage received is reduced by 5.

items.name: Darkwater Talwar
stats: Chance on hit: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy causing 28 Shadow damage.

items.name: Naga Heartpiercer
stats: Chance on hit: Wounds the target for 42 damage. Naga are Stunned for 2 sec.

items.name: Cursed Murloc Eye
stats: Equip: Spells and attacks deal 2 Shadow damage. Deals 4 times as much damage to Murlocs.

items.name: Twilight Maul
stats: Chance on hit: Blasts a target for 70 Nature damage.

items.name: Bite of Serra'kis
stats: Chance on hit: Poisons target for 14 Nature damage every 3 sec for 9 sec.

items.name: Rod of the Sleepwalker
stats: Equip: Reduces the hit chance of Sleep effects against you by 5%.

items.name: Strike of the Hydra
stats: Chance on hit: Inflict 42 Fire and 14 Frost damage, slow the target by 50% for 5 sec, reduce armor by 50, and inflict 7 Nature damage every 3 sec for 12 sec.

items.name: Kam's Walking Stick
stats: Equip: Reduces the duration of all movement impairing effects on you by 10%.

items.name: Boneslicer
stats: Chance on hit: Wounds the target for 70 Physical damage.

items.name: Iron Knuckles
stats: Chance on hit: Pummel the target for 25 damage and interrupt the spell being cast for 5 sec.

items.name: Hydrocane
stats: Equip: Underwater Breath lasts 50% longer than normal.

items.name: Toxic Revenger
stats: Chance on hit: Deals 14 Nature damage every 3 sec to any enemy in an 8 yard radius around the caster for 12 sec.

items.name: Electrocutioner Leg
stats: Chance on hit: Blasts a target for 19 to 37 Nature damage. Mechanical targets take 2x damage.

items.name: Manual Crowd Pummeler
stats: Use: Increases your attack speed by 50% for 30 sec.

items.name: Electromagnetic Gigaflux Reactivator
stats: Use: Channels a bolt of lightning and hurls it towards all enemies in front of the caster causing 152 to 172 Nature damage. The caster is then surrounded by a barrier of electricity for 5 min.

items.name: Thermaplugg's Central Core
stats: Equip: When struck in combat has a 5% chance of inflicting 65 to 121 Nature damage to the attacker.

items.name: Slitherwrap Girdle
stats: Equip: When struck in combat, drain 2 mana from the attacker.

items.name: Violet Sorcerer's Robes
stats: Equip: When damaged, has a chance to reduce threat level on all enemies by a small amount for 10 sec.

items.name: Guardian's Dualblade
stats: Equip: When damaged, has a chance to grant you 1080 armor for 12 sec.

items.name: Archmagister's Faceted Pendant
stats: Use: Increase experience gained from slaying Undead by 10% for 5 min.

items.name: Roogug's Severed Head
stats: Use: Raise the severed head of Roogug, Horrifying and Silencing all Swine within 15 yds for 5 sec.

items.name: Thorncursed Grips
stats: Equip: Your melee weapon attacks deal 2 Nature damage to both you and your target.

items.name: Thornspike
stats: Chance on hit: Hurl spikes at the target, dealing 45 Physical damage and jumping to 1 additional nearby enemy. Each jump reduces the damage by 50%.

items.name: Agamaggan's Clutch
stats: Equip: Increases movement speed by 3% in The Barrens, Thousand Needles, Razorfen Kraul, and Razorfen Downs.

items.name: Painwalker Buckler
stats: Equip: 17% chance when struck in combat to gain 12 mana per 5 sec for 10 sec.

items.name: Torturing Poker
stats: Equip: Melee attacks with this weapon torture the target, dealing 1 Fire damage and increasing your damage dealt to that target with this effect by 1, stacking up to 10 times.

items.name: Dog Whistle
stats: Use: Summons a tracking hound that will protect you for 3 min.

items.name: Loksey's Training Stick
stats: Chance on hit: Discipline the target, dealing 91 Physical damage. Canines and Hyenas are Stunned and sit for 3 sec.

items.name: Spellsever Crossbow
stats: Chance on hit: Launch a magic severing bolt at the target, dealing 36 Physical damage and interrupting the spell being cast for 5 sec.

items.name: Ravager
stats: Chance on hit: Attack all nearby enemies, dealing weapon damage plus 5 every 3 sec for 9 sec, and reducing your own movement speed by 80%.

items.name: Dreadfrost Saber
stats: Equip: Adds 1 Frost damage to your melee attacks.

items.name: Maw of Min'loth
stats: Equip: When struck in melee combat, has a 10% chance of stealing 40 life from the target enemy. (3 sec. cooldown)

items.name: Serpentbane Crown
stats: Use: Inflict 89 to 112 Fire damage and an additional 225 damage over 10 sec. Deals twice as much damage to Beast and Serpentine targets. (5 min. cooldown)

The Drowned City.notes: Stats use current Wowhead Forever tooltips, cross-checked against client records. Deathless Marrow is the explicit item-drop NPC associated with the Deathless Guardians encounter.

items.name: Ambassador's Bloodrobes
items.notes: Rare Ambassador Bloodrage spawns on the entrance approach outside the instance.

items.name: Silky Spider Cape
stats: Equip: Reduces the duration of all movement impairing effects on you by 7%.

items.name: Swine Fists
stats: Equip: Spells and attacks against Swine deal 2 Nature damage.

items.name: X'caliboar
stats: Chance on hit: Unleash a mighty swing, dealing 33 to 51 Holy damage. Deals 3 times as much damage to Undead and Swine.

items.name: Glutton's Cleaver
stats: Chance on hit: Wounds the target, causing it to bleed for 70 damage over 7 sec.

items.name: Coldrage Dagger
stats: Chance on hit: Launches a bolt of frost, dealing 34 to 50 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 50% for 5 sec.

Razorfen Downs.notes: Current Wowhead Forever tooltip stats and explicit drop sources. Includes rare Ragglesnout and rare Ambassador Bloodrage on the entrance approach.
